sample_unit: AI-generated patient education guides (2 tools x 3 imaging modalities)

links.outcome: Readability (grade level, ease score) of AI-generated stroke imaging patient education guides
links.effect: No significant differences between tools; ChatGPT often slightly higher grade levels, DeepSeek higher ease scores for some modalities; reliability uniformly high. Absolute grade levels not reported in abstract.
links.quote: ChatGPT often produced slightly higher grade levels, while DeepSeek AI had higher ease scores for some modalities.

screen.reason: Evaluates the suitability and readability of patient education materials generated by two LLMs (ChatGPT and DeepSeek) using standard readability and quality metrics without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
